description: This file defines the S3EncryptionClientV2 class, which provides a wrapper around the AWS S3 client to handle encryption and decryption of objects during upload and download operations, with support for async calls and metadata management.

classes.name: S3EncryptionClientV2
classes.description: A class that wraps an S3Client providing automatic encryption when uploading objects and decryption when retrieving objects, supporting both sync and async operations, metadata management, and configurable encryption strategies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client with an S3Client instance, optional instruction file suffix, and sets up metrics collection.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Encrypts data and asynchronously uploads an object to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Encrypts data and uploads an object to S3 synchronously by waiting for the promise returned by putObjectAsync.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an object from S3 asynchronously and decrypts the data, returning a promise.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 synchronously.
